title: LTFRB's monetary aid allows Iloilo transport coop to deploy full fleet

blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Government financial assistance is allowing a transport cooperative in Iloilo to deploy all 95 of its modernized jeepneys despite rising fuel costs, the transport group’s chairperson said Wednesday. Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) chair Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon said the cooperative expects to receive the P20,000 monthly assistance per unit from the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) within the week. WVTC operates 95 modernized jeepneys serving routes from the Mohon, Ungka and Tagbak terminals to Iloilo City. “This is a big help for us. Imagine, that is P20,000 per unit per month.
